answer: Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. Because the thread partition is computed from the tide history, the copper audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 18 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
